video:video.video:title: Anchor-Align teaser: generalizable VLA finetuning for robot manipulation
video:video.video:description: Narrated overview of Anchor-Align. Behavior cloning erases pretrained VLM representations; Vision-Language Anchoring and Language-Action Alignment restore out-of-distribution generalization on a UFactory xArm7 robot, LIBERO-PRO, LIBERO-Plus and CALVIN.
